title: VISASQ/COLEMAN Opens First Latin American Office in Bogotá to Support U.S. Business
summary: VISASQ/COLEMAN opened an expert recruitment team in Bogotá, Colombia — its first office in Latin America — to support its U.S. business, which it says has seen rising demand for expert interviews since the M&A market recovered in 2025. The company said its network covers 190 countries and over 800,000 experts as of the end of March 2026. CEO Eiko Hashiba said the U.S. interview business has continued to grow steadily.
whyItMatters: Bogotá is becoming a nearshore hub for expert-network operations serving U.S. clients — Dialectica also has an office there — and the release confirms VISASQ/COLEMAN's U.S. unit is growing again after the 2024 goodwill write-off.
